blackout._help: Whole days with no trading, and stock-specific days (e.g. its earnings date). YYYY-MM-DD. YOU maintain this. Dates marked unverified: check federalreserve.gov.
blackout.dates_note: FOMC decision days. Oct 28 is confirmed by several sources. Dec 9: most sources say Dec 8-9, one says Dec 16, so check federalreserve.gov. Past 2026 dates are listed so the backtester skips the same days the live bot would. Add earlier years' dates yourself to make a longer backtest honest.

skills._help: The bot runs your trader-* skill scripts. dir = folder holding trader-scanner, trader-news, ... (copies are included). Set a REAL name+email in sec_user_agent (SEC requires it) for filings and earnings data.

notify._help: Telegram alerts. Needs TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID in the environment (see notify.py). Never put the token in this file.

watchdog._help: watchdog.py is a separate program. It alerts if the bot's heartbeat goes stale during market hours; with --flatten it also closes all positions after flatten_after_seconds.

realtime._help: Event-driven mode: live 1-minute bars, live news and your order updates arrive over websockets (free IEX feed), so the bot reacts within seconds instead of every 20. gate = Claude gets a last veto/shrink on each breakout; position_review = Claude may close a position on breaking news. Turn any off with false. If a feed dies the bot falls back to 20-second polling.

learning._help: Nightly learning (research/daily.py, started by the dashboard at 16:20 New York): adds the day's data, forward-tests the strategy candidates, and Claude reviews the day and keeps lessons. use_lessons = show the active lessons to Claude's premarket call as hints; they never change risk limits or rules.

gap_fade._help: Gap-down reversion (strategies.py; research: study 3). Buys stocks that open min_gap_pct+ below yesterday's close, at the first minute's close; stop atr_k x ATR(14) below; target rr x risk. Entries only until last_entry. risk_skill = settings the trader-risk skill uses in this mode (entries from 09:31; reward:risk floor 0.9 so cent rounding cannot block a planned 1R trade). Set strategy back to "orb" to return to the opening-range breakout.
